claim: The snapshot runner falls back to snapshotV2DefaultBatchSize when neither the payload nor the source object sets a batch size.
The activity log written field is the batch written count, which accumulates RowsAffected of the upsert statements.
The batch upsert DO UPDATE clause only updates when _hash or _deleted differs from the incoming row.
The snapshot batch buffer size is at least 1000.
The batch upsert DO UPDATE clause always updates every conflicting row regardless of hash.
